blocks.prompt: 2 (i) [printed as i)] Find the rank of the following matrix: \(\begin{bmatrix}1 & -1 & 3 & 1 \\ -2 & -6 & 1 & -1 \\ 3 & 1 & 4 & -2\end{bmatrix}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh rank ka sawal hai: rank yani echelon form mein non-zero rows ki tadaad.
Jawab sirf ek number hai.
Plan: column ba column leading 1 banayenge aur us ke neeche zero, zero rows ko neeche bhejenge, phir non-zero rows ginenge. Jahan ho sake 1 wali row ko upar laa kar fractions se bachenge.
Dhyan dein: rank nikalte waqt reduced form tak jana zaroori nahi, sirf echelon form kaafi hai. Aam ghalti yeh hai ke students zero row ko bhi gin lete hain, ya ek row ko apne hi multiple se minus kar ke zero bana dete hain jo jaiz nahi ("\(R_2 - R_2\)" koi row operation nahi). Yaad rakhein: \(m \times n\) matrix ka rank kabhi \(m\) ya \(n\) dono mein se chhote number se zyada nahi ho sakta, is se apna jawab foran check kar sakte hain.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & -1 & 3 & 1 \\ -2 & -6 & 1 & -1 \\ 3 & 1 & 4 & -2\end{bmatrix}\), yeh \(3 \times 4\) matrix hai.
Humein find karna hai: \(A\) ka rank.
Tareeqa: Row operations se \(A\) ko echelon form mein laayenge. Phir jitni rows non-zero bachein, wohi rank hai. Row operations rank ko nahi badalte, is liye echelon form ka rank hi asal matrix ka rank hai.

Column 1 mein leading 1 ke neeche zero
Row operation: \(R_2 + 2R_1 \to R_2'\), \(R_3 + (-3)R_1 \to R_3'\)
\(R_2'\): \(-2 + 2 = 0\), \(-6 - 2 = -8\), \(1 + 6 = 7\), \(-1 + 2 = 1\)
\(R_3'\): \(3 - 3 = 0\), \(1 + 3 = 4\), \(4 - 9 = -5\), \(-2 - 3 = -5\)
\[\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & -1 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & -8 & 7 & 1 \\ 0 & 4 & -5 & -5\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(R_1\) ka leading entry pehle se 1 hai. \(R_2\) ka \(-2\) mitane ke liye \(2R_1\) jama kiya, aur \(R_3\) ka 3 mitane ke liye \(3R_1\) minus kiya.

Row 2 mein leading 1
Row operation: \(\left(-\frac{1}{8}\right)R_2 \to R_2'\)
\(R_2'\): \(0\), \(1\), \(-\frac{7}{8}\), \(-\frac{1}{8}\)
\[\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & -1 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & -\frac{7}{8} & -\frac{1}{8} \\ 0 & 4 & -5 & -5\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(R_2\) ka pehla non-zero entry \(-8\) hai; poori row ko \(-8\) se divide kiya to woh 1 ban gaya. Rank ke liye yeh zaroori nahi, lekin book ki echelon form mein leading entry 1 hoti hai.

Column 2 mein leading 1 ke neeche zero
Row operation: \(R_3 + (-4)R_2 \to R_3'\)
\(R_3'\): \(0 + 0 = 0\), \(4 - 4 = 0\), \(-5 + \frac{7}{2} = -\frac{3}{2}\), \(-5 + \frac{1}{2} = -\frac{9}{2}\)
\[\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & -1 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & -\frac{7}{8} & -\frac{1}{8} \\ 0 & 0 & -\frac{3}{2} & -\frac{9}{2}\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(R_3\) ka column 2 wala entry 4 hai, \(4 - 4(1) = 0\). Fractions ko common denominator se jama karein: \(-5 + \frac{7}{2} = -\frac{3}{2}\).

Row 3 mein leading 1
Row operation: \(\left(-\frac{2}{3}\right)R_3 \to R_3'\)
\(R_3'\): \(0\), \(0\), \(1\), \(3\)
\[\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & -1 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & -\frac{7}{8} & -\frac{1}{8} \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 3\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(-\frac{3}{2}\) ko 1 banane ke liye us ke ulte (reciprocal) \(-\frac{2}{3}\) se zarb kiya. Ab matrix echelon form mein hai: har leading 1 pichhli row ke leading 1 se right par hai.

Non-zero rows ginein
Echelon form mein 3 rows non-zero hain.
\[\text{Rank of } A = 3\]
Kyun: Rank ki definition yahi hai: echelon form mein non-zero rows ki tadaad. Tasdeeq ke liye yaad rakhein ke \(3 \times 4\) matrix ka rank 3 se zyada nahi ho sakta, aur hamara jawab is had ke andar hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (ii) Find the rank of the following matrix: \(\begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 3 \\ 2 & -4 & 6 \\ -1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -1\end{bmatrix}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh rank ka sawal hai: rank yani echelon form mein non-zero rows ki tadaad.
Jawab sirf ek number hai.
Plan: column ba column leading 1 banayenge aur us ke neeche zero, zero rows ko neeche bhejenge, phir non-zero rows ginenge. Jahan ho sake 1 wali row ko upar laa kar fractions se bachenge.
Dhyan dein: rank nikalte waqt reduced form tak jana zaroori nahi, sirf echelon form kaafi hai. Aam ghalti yeh hai ke students zero row ko bhi gin lete hain, ya ek row ko apne hi multiple se minus kar ke zero bana dete hain jo jaiz nahi ("\(R_2 - R_2\)" koi row operation nahi). Yaad rakhein: \(m \times n\) matrix ka rank kabhi \(m\) ya \(n\) dono mein se chhote number se zyada nahi ho sakta, is se apna jawab foran check kar sakte hain.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(A = \begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 3 \\ 2 & -4 & 6 \\ -1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -1\end{bmatrix}\), yeh \(4 \times 3\) matrix hai.
Humein find karna hai: \(A\) ka rank.
Tareeqa: Row operations se \(A\) ko echelon form mein laayenge. Phir jitni rows non-zero bachein, wohi rank hai. Row operations rank ko nahi badalte, is liye echelon form ka rank hi asal matrix ka rank hai.

Column 1 mein leading 1 ke neeche zero
Row operation: \(R_2 + (-2)R_1 \to R_2'\), \(R_3 + R_1 \to R_3'\)
\(R_2'\): \(2 - 2 = 0\), \(-4 + 4 = 0\), \(6 - 6 = 0\)
\(R_3'\): \(-1 + 1 = 0\), \(0 - 2 = -2\), \(2 + 3 = 5\)
\[\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & -1\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(R_2\) se \(2R_1\) minus kiya aur \(R_3\) mein \(R_1\) jama kiya. \(R_4\) pehle se 0 se shuru hoti hai. Dilchasp baat: \(R_2\) poori zero ho gayi, kyunke yeh shuru se hi \(R_1\) ka double thi.

Zero row ko neeche bhej dein
Row operation: \(R_2 \leftrightarrow R_4\)
\[\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & -2 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: Echelon form mein zero rows hamesha sab se neeche hoti hain. \(R_4\) ko upar laane ka faida yeh bhi hai ke us ka leading entry pehle se 1 hai.

Column 2 mein leading 1 ke neeche zero
Row operation: \(R_3 + 2R_2 \to R_3'\)
\(R_3'\): \(0 + 0 = 0\), \(-2 + 2 = 0\), \(5 - 2 = 3\)
\[\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(R_3\) ka column 2 wala entry \(-2\) hai; \(2R_2\) jama karne se zero ho gaya.

Row 3 mein leading 1
Row operation: \(\frac{1}{3}R_3 \to R_3'\)
\(R_3'\): \(0\), \(0\), \(1\)
\[\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 3 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: 3 se divide kiya to leading entry 1 ho gaya. Ab matrix echelon form mein hai, aur zero row sab se neeche hai.

Non-zero rows ginein
Echelon form mein 3 rows non-zero hain.
\[\text{Rank of } A = 3\]
Kyun: Rank ki definition yahi hai: echelon form mein non-zero rows ki tadaad. Tasdeeq ke liye yaad rakhein ke \(4 \times 3\) matrix ka rank 3 se zyada nahi ho sakta, aur hamara jawab is had ke andar hai.

blocks.prompt: 2 (iii) Find the rank of the following matrix: \(\begin{bmatrix}3 & -1 & 3 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & -1 & -3 & -2 \\ 2 & 3 & 4 & 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 5 & -2 & -3 & 3\end{bmatrix}\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh rank ka sawal hai: rank yani echelon form mein non-zero rows ki tadaad.
Jawab sirf ek number hai.
Plan: column ba column leading 1 banayenge aur us ke neeche zero, zero rows ko neeche bhejenge, phir non-zero rows ginenge. Jahan ho sake 1 wali row ko upar laa kar fractions se bachenge.
Dhyan dein: rank nikalte waqt reduced form tak jana zaroori nahi, sirf echelon form kaafi hai. Aam ghalti yeh hai ke students zero row ko bhi gin lete hain, ya ek row ko apne hi multiple se minus kar ke zero bana dete hain jo jaiz nahi ("\(R_2 - R_2\)" koi row operation nahi). Yaad rakhein: \(m \times n\) matrix ka rank kabhi \(m\) ya \(n\) dono mein se chhote number se zyada nahi ho sakta, is se apna jawab foran check kar sakte hain.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(A = \begin{bmatrix}3 & -1 & 3 & 0 & 1 \\ 1 & 2 & -1 & -3 & -2 \\ 2 & 3 & 4 & 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 5 & -2 & -3 & 3\end{bmatrix}\), yeh \(4 \times 5\) matrix hai.
Humein find karna hai: \(A\) ka rank.
Tareeqa: Row operations se \(A\) ko echelon form mein laayenge. Phir jitni rows non-zero bachein, wohi rank hai. Row operations rank ko nahi badalte, is liye echelon form ka rank hi asal matrix ka rank hai.

Column 1 mein 1 ko upar layein
Row operation: \(R_1 \leftrightarrow R_2\)
\[\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -1 & -3 & -2 \\ 3 & -1 & 3 & 0 & 1 \\ 2 & 3 & 4 & 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 5 & -2 & -3 & 3\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(R_2\) ka pehla entry 1 hai. Is ko upar laane se fractions se bach jate hain, warna 3 ko 1 banane ke liye poori row ko 3 se divide karna parta.

Column 1 mein leading 1 ke neeche zero
Row operation: \(R_2 + (-3)R_1 \to R_2'\), \(R_3 + (-2)R_1 \to R_3'\), \(R_4 + (-2)R_1 \to R_4'\)
\(R_2'\): \(3 - 3 = 0\), \(-1 - 6 = -7\), \(3 + 3 = 6\), \(0 + 9 = 9\), \(1 + 6 = 7\)
\(R_3'\): \(2 - 2 = 0\), \(3 - 4 = -1\), \(4 + 2 = 6\), \(2 + 6 = 8\), \(1 + 4 = 5\)
\(R_4'\): \(2 - 2 = 0\), \(5 - 4 = 1\), \(-2 + 2 = 0\), \(-3 + 6 = 3\), \(3 + 4 = 7\)
\[\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -1 & -3 & -2 \\ 0 & -7 & 6 & 9 & 7 \\ 0 & -1 & 6 & 8 & 5 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 & 7\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: Teeno rows ke pehle entries 3, 2, 2 hain, is liye \(R_1\) ko 3, 2 aur 2 se zarb kar ke minus kiya. Har row ke paanch entries dhyan se calculate karein, ek sign ki ghalti poora rank badal sakti hai.

Row 2 ke pivot par 1 layein
Row operation: \(R_2 \leftrightarrow R_4\)
\[\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -1 & -3 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 & 7 \\ 0 & -1 & 6 & 8 & 5 \\ 0 & -7 & 6 & 9 & 7\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(R_4\) ke column 2 mein 1 hai; usay row 2 ki jagah le aaye taa ke fractions na banein.

Column 3 mein pivot ke neeche zero
Row operation: \(R_4 + (-1)R_3 \to R_4'\)
\(R_4'\): \(0 + 0 = 0\), \(0 + 0 = 0\), \(6 - 6 = 0\), \(30 - 11 = 19\), \(56 - 12 = 44\)
\[\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -1 & -3 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 6 & 11 & 12 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 19 & 44\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(R_3\) aur \(R_4\) dono ka column 3 wala entry 6 hai, is liye \(R_4 - R_3\) se seedha zero aa gaya, koi fraction nahi bana.

Row 3 aur row 4 mein leading 1
Row operation: \(\frac{1}{6}R_3 \to R_3'\), \(\frac{1}{19}R_4 \to R_4'\)
\(R_3'\): \(0\), \(0\), \(1\), \(\frac{11}{6}\), \(2\)
\(R_4'\): \(0\), \(0\), \(0\), \(1\), \(\frac{44}{19}\)
\[\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & 2 & -1 & -3 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 3 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & \frac{11}{6} & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1 & \frac{44}{19}\end{bmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(R_3\) ko 6 se aur \(R_4\) ko 19 se divide kiya. Ab matrix echelon form mein hai; koi row zero nahi bani.

Non-zero rows ginein
Echelon form mein 4 rows non-zero hain.
\[\text{Rank of } A = 4\]
Kyun: Rank ki definition yahi hai: echelon form mein non-zero rows ki tadaad. Tasdeeq ke liye yaad rakhein ke \(4 \times 5\) matrix ka rank 4 se zyada nahi ho sakta, aur hamara jawab is had ke andar hai.
